name: target_la
description: T_GB^LA(P) = V(P) and A(P) and C(P) and Q(P): probe poses producing an acceptable long-axis GB view; A = long axis in the image plane (<= 20 deg) and not beam-parallel (presentation angle phi >= 45 deg: the GB runs more across the image than along the beam)
status: frozen 2026-10-23 (final; chosen on train/val only incl. the phi >= 45 deg presentation rule; not to be adjusted)

applicability.status: frozen 2026-10-23 (thresholds derived on train/val only; test labelled with the frozen rules)
applicability.rule_applicable: applicable iff axis instability <= max_axis_instability_deg (half the 20 deg alignment tolerance; 1-voxel erosion, dilation, 20 random boundary perturbations)
applicability.rule_available: available iff T_subcostal-LA (dense subcostal bank) is non-empty
applicability.rule_difficult: difficult iff available and |T_subcostal-LA| / |sampled A_subcostal poses| < f_min = 5th percentile over applicable, available train/val studies

approach.status: frozen 2026-10-23 after the dense-sampling QC (train/val only). A_subcostal is our operationalisation of the clinically described right-subcostal approach, not a clinical standard. T_subcostal-LA = T_LA ∩ A_subcostal

target.name: T_subcostal-LA
target.definition: T_LA ∩ A_subcostal; possibly multimodal (T = T1 ∪ T2), the error to a prediction is the distance to the closest valid pose
target.pose_distance: skin mm + rotation deg, rotation modulo the 180 deg flip about the beam (roll + 180 shows the same plane mirrored)
